spans.text: The alcohol pictures cue reactivity task ( ) was designed for neuroimaging studies and consisted of 22 stimuli in each of 4 categories: alcohol, non-alcohol, alcohol active control, and non-alcohol active controls.

description.value: A picture cue-reactivity task presenting alcohol, non-alcohol, and shuffled control images.

Alcohol beverage pictures presented for 750 ms, followed by a 1250 ms inter-stimulus interval; participants rated each image as Like, Neutral, or Dislike using three buttons. The 22 alcohol stimuli were each presented four times, for 88 trials.

Non-alcohol beverage pictures presented for 750 ms, followed by a 1250 ms inter-stimulus interval; participants rated each image as Like, Neutral, or Dislike using three buttons. The 22 non-alcohol beverage stimuli were each presented four times, for 88 trials.

instructions.value: Participants were asked to respond whether they “Like”, feel “Neutral”, or “Dislike” each image within 2000 ms using 3 buttons on a MRI-compatible button box.
